name: Gondwana & Divine Clothing Co.
old_description: Embrace the serene charm of this polka dot wine sweater, thoughtfully designed for an etherial vibe. With elbow length balloon sleeves and a classic mock neckline, this sweater exudes a relaxed yet fashionable aura. Refresh your wardrobe with this adorable piece!
about:
Gondwana & Divine Clothing Co. operates a women's apparel boutique in Concord, New Hampshire, with an accompanying e-commerce site at gondwanaclothing.com. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The store stocks a curated selection of women's sweaters, dresses, cardigans, hats, and accessories from established designer labels including Clara Sunwoo, Habitat, Salaam, Free People, and Desigual. Merchandise ranges from lightweight knits and faux-fur headwear to structured dresses and textured merino-blend cardigans such as the Chocolate Textured Merino Cardigan (38% Merino Wool, 38% Acrylic, 24% Nylon). Operations span a physical storefront in Concord and an online shop offering free shipping on orders over $150.

The retailer serves individual consumers seeking contemporary women's fashion across a range of sizes and styles. Customer testimonials highlight the breadth of options for different body types and the staff's emphasis on personalized service.

The company distinguishes itself through attentive in-store assistance and a multi-brand assortment designed to accommodate varied silhouettes. Shoppers consistently note the team's willingness to help customers find flattering fits across the carried lines.
